snippet.title: MAFATE - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Can you bring life back to a forgotten place through simple acts?

Stamps of Nature is a cozy exploration experience where you play as a postman in the remote Cirque de Mafate, in the Indian Ocean.

Take photos, deliver letters, and connect with the local community while uncovering a heartfelt story alongside Luna, a girl mysteriously transformed into a camera.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3133220/MAFATE/


🌿 About the Game

📸 A Journey Through Mafate
• Explore a remote and picturesque valley inspired by Réunion Island
• Capture meaningful moments through photography

📬 Deliver and Connect
• Deliver letters to the locals and learn their stories
• Help residents with small tasks and make a difference

📷 A Unique Companion
• Travel alongside Luna, a girl turned into a camera
• Experience a magical narrative that blends past and present

🐾 Interact with Nature
• Control animals to reach hidden locations
• Care for creatures and uncover secrets across the world

🌎 A Cozy and Cultural Experience
• Immerse yourself in a world inspired by Creole culture
• Relaxing gameplay focused on exploration and connection
